name: Creative Giants
mood: oversized editorial poster on cream paper
summary: Poster-scale editorial system using warm Bone White canvas, huge 300-weight Switzer headlines, sharp full-bleed photography, black pill controls, zero-radius cards and images, and tiny saturated accent hits.
useWhen: Creative studio and production company sites
Art collectives, cultural campaigns, and immersive activation portfolios
Editorial project grids and case-study experiences
Interfaces where photography and headline scale should dominate
avoidWhen: Apps that need many nested controls
Interfaces relying on heavy shadows, rounded cards, or high component density
Brands that need conventional marketing sections and repeated CTAs

boneWhite.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark accents, warm paper tone

inkBlack.role: Text, icons, black menu pill, high contrast details

graphite.role: Secondary body text, captions, metadata, helper copy

ash.role: Input borders, inactive links, tertiary dividers, quiet outlines

charcoalScale.role: Warm gray for list borders and rare dark gradient track

magentaBloom.role: Decorative pink accent, low-frequency emphasis, editorial borders

forestTeal.role: Saturated accent for card frames, strokes, and duotone treatments

powderBlue.role: Soft card background, cool wash, muted illustration fill

candyPink.role: Pastel card surface and high-key editorial tint

mintWash.role: Pastel card surface and calm cool accent block

navyInk.role: Deep accent card surface and rare inverted text ground

signalYellow.role: Tiny badges, tag pills, hover state, sporadic high-chroma highlight

imagery.direction: Full-bleed editorial photography, studio documentation, gallery shots, public installations, contact-sheet crops, sharp image corners.
imagery.avoid: Rounded image cards, stock gradients, generic SaaS illustrations, busy UI chrome, image drop shadows.
